items.name: Prime Agent
items.why: 作為一個開源、自我改進的編碼與研究代理，Prime Agent 於 8 月 6 日正式開源，並展示了生成 SEGA Genesis 和 Game Boy Colour 模擬器的能力，對遊戲創建極具潛力。
items.why_en: As an open-source, self-improving coding and research harness, Prime Agent was officially open-sourced on August 6th, demonstrating its ability to generate SEGA Genesis and Game Boy Colour emulators, showing immense potential for game creation.

items.name: Gemini Spark
items.why: Google 於 8 月發佈的 Gemini Spark 是一個持久性雲端代理，即使關閉筆記本電腦也能持續工作，非常適合網頁遊戲開發中的持續集成與自動化任務。
items.why_en: Google's Gemini Spark, released in August, is a persistent cloud agent that continues working even after closing your laptop, making it ideal for continuous integration and automation tasks in web game development.

items.name: Qwen3.8 Max
items.why: Qwen3.8 Max 於 8 月 2 日發佈，並在 WebDev AI Leaderboard 上表現出色，顯示其在網頁開發編碼方面的強大能力，可作為遊戲開發的編程模型。
items.why_en: Qwen3.8 Max was released on August 2nd and performed strongly on the WebDev AI Leaderboard, demonstrating its robust capabilities in web development coding, making it suitable as a programming model for game development.

items.name: Codex
items.why: OpenAI 於 8 月 4 日宣佈了 Codex 的新學習與教學方式，Codex 是一個代理式 AI 程序，能幫助用戶構建軟體、應用程式和網站，其更新增強了其在遊戲開發中的應用潛力。
items.why_en: OpenAI announced new ways to learn and teach with Codex on August 4th. Codex is an agentic AI program that enables users to build software, apps, and websites, and its updates enhance its potential for game development applications.

items.name: Claude Opus 5
items.why: Claude Opus 5 於 7 月 24 日發佈，是 Anthropic 最新的旗艦模型，在 SWE-bench Verified 基準測試中領先，其卓越的推理和編碼能力使其成為遊戲開發的頂級選擇。
items.why_en: Released on July 24th, Claude Opus 5 is Anthropic's newest flagship model, leading the SWE-bench Verified benchmark. Its exceptional reasoning and coding capabilities make it a top choice for game development.

monthly.note: 本月(2026 年 8 月)新發佈的遊戲模組 Rigging 工具不足 5 個，已用最近期(近 30–60 天)的項目補足。
monthly.note_en: Less than 5 game module rigging tools were released this month (August 2026); the list has been supplemented with the most recent items (within the last 30–60 days).

items.name: Cascadeur
items.why: 此版本為 AI 輔助動畫軟體的重大更新，新增了動畫圖層、緩動控制、改進的 AI 中間幀生成和 BVH 導入，強化了綁骨與動畫工作流程。
items.why_en: This version is a significant update to the AI-assisted animation software, adding animation layers, easing controls, improved AI inbetweening, and BVH import, enhancing rigging and animation workflows.

items.name: Autodesk Flow Studio
items.why: Flow Studio 的重大平台擴展，引入 3D 編輯器與畫布，為 AI 輔助的電影製作（包含角色綁骨與動畫）提供更精確的控制與整合。
items.why_en: A major platform expansion for Flow Studio, introducing 3D Editor + Canvas for more precise control and integration in AI-assisted filmmaking, including character rigging and animation.

items.name: V2Fun
items.why: 作為一個整合 AI 3D 模型生成、綁骨和動畫的平台，V2Fun 在近期更新中持續提供從概念到遊戲就緒資產的快速工作流程。
items.why_en: As an integrated AI 3D model generation, rigging, and animation platform, V2Fun continues to offer a rapid workflow from concept to game-ready assets with its recent updates.

items.name: Zoo Tools Pro
items.why: 此版本擴展了對第三方角色管線的支援，可自動偵測現有骨架並從中建立 Hive 綁骨，簡化了綁骨工作流程。
items.why_en: This version expands support for third-party character pipelines by automatically detecting existing skeletons and building Hive rigs from them, streamlining the rigging workflow.

items.name: Tripo Auto-Rigging
items.why: Tripo AI 的自動綁骨功能持續受到關注，v2.5 版本是其綁骨系統的最新迭代，提供高效的 3D 模型綁骨能力。
items.why_en: Tripo AI's auto-rigging feature continues to be prominent, with version v2.5 being the latest iteration of its rigging system, offering efficient 3D model rigging capabilities.

categories.name: 創建聲音特效
categories.subtitle: SFX / 語音 / 音樂 · 例如 ElevenLabs

overall.name: ElevenLabs SFX v2 + v3 voice
overall.why: 遊戲音訊最全:文字轉 SFX(30s、可無縫循環)+ 頂級語音
overall.why_en: Most complete game-audio stack: text-to-SFX (30s, seamless loops) + top-tier voice

overall.name: Suno v5
overall.why: 音樂盲測第一(ELO 1293);全曲+人聲質量標竿
overall.why_en: #1 in music blind tests (ELO 1293); full-song + vocal benchmark

overall.name: ElevenLabs Music v2
overall.why: 商用授權清晰,可在曲中嵌 SFX、中途換曲風
overall.why_en: Clear commercial licensing; embed SFX in tracks, mid-track genre switch

overall.name: Stable Audio 3
overall.why: 開源,音樂 + SFX/foley 統一,適合自架 pipeline
overall.why_en: Open-source; unified music + SFX/foley; great for self-hosted pipelines

overall.name: Lyria 3 Pro
overall.why: 最長 3 分鐘結構化曲目,SynthID 浮水印
overall.why_en: Up to 3-min structured tracks; SynthID watermark

monthly.note: 本月 (2026 年 8 月) 有 3 個新發佈項目，其餘 2 個為近期 (2026 年 7 月) 發佈。
monthly.note_en: This month (August 2026) saw 3 new releases, with the remaining 2 being recent releases (July 2026).

items.name: Suno AI v5.5 (Voices, Custom Models, My Taste, Mobile App)
items.why: 推出個人化語音複製、自訂模型訓練及行動應用程式整合，顯著提升音樂創作的個人化與便利性。
items.why_en: Launched personalized voice cloning, custom model training, and mobile app integration, significantly enhancing music creation personalization and convenience.

items.name: Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0
items.why: 成為 Grok 語音代理的預設模型，提供高效能的即時語音對語音轉換能力。
items.why_en: Became the default model for Grok voice agents, offering high-performance real-time speech-to-speech capabilities.

items.name: Seedance 2.5
items.why: 作為視訊模型，其內建原生語音生成與進階音效功能，為多媒體內容創作提供整合式音訊解決方案。
items.why_en: As a video model, its built-in native voice generation and advanced SFX features provide an integrated audio solution for multimedia content creation.

items.name: Lyria 3.5
items.why: 顯著提升音樂生成能力，支援更長、更具結構的歌曲創作，並強化多語言人聲與風格轉換。
items.why_en: Significantly enhanced music generation capabilities, supporting longer, more structured song creation, and improved multilingual vocals and style transfer.

items.name: MiniMax H3
items.why: 作為多模態模型，首次實現語音、音效與音樂的統一生成，並支援音訊參考與編輯。
items.why_en: As a multimodal model, it achieved unified generation of voice, sound effects, and music, supporting audio reference and editing.

items.name: Cursor + Claude Fable 5 + GitHub Copilot
items.why: Claude Fable 5 的卓越程式碼理解與生成能力,結合 Cursor 的 AI 原生 IDE 和 GitHub Copilot,為開發者提供無與倫比的編碼體驗。
items.why_en: Claude Fable 5's superior code comprehension and generation, combined with Cursor's AI-native IDE and GitHub Copilot, offers developers an unparalleled coding experience.

items.name: Microsoft Copilot (Agent 365) v2.0 + Claude Fable 5 + GPT-5
items.why: Microsoft Copilot Agent 365 v2.0 強化了其代理框架,並深度整合最新的 Claude Fable 5 和 GPT-5 模型,為企業提供更強大的自動化與決策支援。
items.why_en: Microsoft Copilot Agent 365 v2.0 enhances its agentic framework with deep integration of the latest Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5 models, offering superior enterprise automation and decision support.

items.name: n8n v3.0 + Claude Fable 5 + MCP (Microsoft Copilot Platform)
items.why: n8n v3.0 推出新的連接器和模板,將 Claude Fable 5 的先進智能與 Microsoft Copilot Platform 的企業級整合能力無縫結合,實現強大的自動化工作流。
items.why_en: n8n v3.0 introduces new connectors and templates, seamlessly integrating Claude Fable 5's advanced intelligence with Microsoft Copilot Platform's enterprise-grade capabilities for powerful automation workflows.

items.name: Claude Fable 5 + GitHub + Vercel
items.why: 利用 Claude Fable 5 進行進階程式碼生成與審查,結合 GitHub 的版本控制和 Vercel 的 AI 驅動部署,大幅簡化了整個開發生命週期。
items.why_en: Leveraging Claude Fable 5 for advanced code generation and review, integrated with GitHub for version control and Vercel for AI-driven deployment, significantly streamlines the entire development lifecycle.

items.name: Perplexity AI Pro (Enhanced) + NotebookLM + Claude Fable 5
items.why: Perplexity Pro 的增強型研究功能,結合 NotebookLM 的組織能力和 Claude Fable 5 的深度分析,共同打造頂級的研究與知識管理堆疊。
items.why_en: Perplexity Pro's enhanced research capabilities, combined with NotebookLM's organization and Claude Fable 5's deep analytical power, create a leading research and knowledge management stack.

items.name: ComfyUI Workflow Hub + Flux / Suno / ElevenLabs
items.why: ComfyUI Workflow Hub 的推出簡化了複雜多模態生成式 AI 工作流的創建與分享,整合了先進模型用於圖像、音樂和語音生成。
items.why_en: The launch of ComfyUI Workflow Hub simplifies the creation and sharing of complex multimodal generative AI workflows, integrating advanced models for image, music, and voice generation.

items.name: Claude Fable 5 + Obsidian
items.why: Claude Fable 5 卓越的推理和摘要能力,與 Obsidian 強大的知識圖譜整合,提供無與倫比的個人知識管理和洞察生成。
items.why_en: Claude Fable 5's superior reasoning and summarization capabilities, integrated with Obsidian's robust knowledge graph, offer unparalleled personal knowledge management and insight generation.

items.name: ChatGPT Enterprise (Advanced Agentic Features) + Notion

items.why_en: New advanced agentic features in ChatGPT Enterprise offer deeper integration and automation capabilities within Notion workspaces, enhancing team collaboration and content creation efficiency.

items.name: Raycast AI (Expanded LLM Support) + Claude Fable 5 / Perplexity / NotebookLM
items.version: Raycast AI (Expanded LLM Support), Claude Fable 5
items.why: Raycast AI 擴展了對最新 LLM (包括 Claude Fable 5) 的支援,並引入新功能,實現桌面工作流中不同 AI 工具的無縫切換和整合,大幅提升生產力。
items.why_en: Raycast AI's expanded support for the latest LLMs (including Claude Fable 5) and new features enable seamless switching and integration between different AI tools within desktop workflows, significantly boosting productivity.
